versions.changelog:
Initial release of keyapi-instagram providing secure, scenario-driven Instagram API access through KeyAPI.

- Converts natural-language Instagram goals into KeyAPI REST workflows using live, up-to-date documentation.
- Enforces hard rules to always use KeyAPI API and docs as the sole data source—never substitutes with manual web lookups.
- Includes robust onboarding: assists with Bearer token setup and local configuration scripts, only resuming execution after credentials are confirmed available.
- Implements detailed user-guided workflow for scenario selection, endpoint resolution, missing input handling, and result presentation.
- Provides helper scripts for authentication, live documentation search, and API calls to ensure accurate API usage.
- Focuses on privacy, data accuracy, clear user communication, and minimizes user effort by preferring scenarios with strongest filtering and least input requirement.
